body:
Hello Alberto, 

I revised the Dutch translation of ART and noticed that at the end of the file Nederlands, there's a line that says:
"added with automatic translation",
followed by some 60 auto translations (which still have to be edited). 

It's also present in the French language file, only 10 auto translations. 

Question: who added those automatic translations, where do they come from? 

Regards, Paul.
title: Language files: # added with automatic translation
